client/src/components/access/AccessLevel.name: Access level picker
client/src/components/access/AccessLevel.description: Lets an admin choose who a form, agent or app is open to: only them, their organization, or everyone.

client/src/components/access/AccessMap.t.name: Access map
client/src/components/access/AccessMap.t.description: Lays out on one grid every place a person's roles apply and every permission they hold there.

client/src/components/access/AccessTrace.name: Access check trace
client/src/components/access/AccessTrace.description: Walks through each access check in order, showing what passed, what stopped it, and why.

client/src/components/access/GrantChip.t.name: Grant chip
client/src/components/access/GrantChip.t.description: Shows one permission a role grants, highlighted when it is powerful or applies everywhere.

client/src/components/access/PermissionC.name: Permission chip
client/src/components/access/PermissionC.description: Shows one permission a person holds, marked plainly when it reaches beyond a single organization.

client/src/components/access/PlaceLabel..name: Place label
client/src/components/access/PlaceLabel..description: Shows where access applies, with a small icon for the kind of place.

client/src/components/access/ReachChip.t.name: Reach chip
client/src/components/access/ReachChip.t.description: Shows one place a person's access reaches, on a single line.

client/src/components/access/TestAccessP.name: Test access panel
client/src/components/access/TestAccessP.description: Lets an admin try a real action as a chosen person or identity to see whether access would be allowed.

client/src/components/applications/Appli.name: Apps list
client/src/components/applications/Appli.description: Lists the apps in the workspace with their status and open actions, folding into short cards on phones.

client/src/components/applications/Appli.name: App update badge
client/src/components/applications/Appli.description: Flags an app built with an older toolkit so its owner knows a refresh is available.

client/src/components/applications/AppRe.name: Repoint app source
client/src/components/applications/AppRe.description: Points an app at a different source folder when its files have moved.

client/src/components/audit/AuditEventDr.name: Audit event detail
client/src/components/audit/AuditEventDr.description: Opens one activity record to show what happened, who did it, where, and to what.

client/src/components/audit/RunUserLabel.name: Acting user label
client/src/components/audit/RunUserLabel.description: Shows which person, identity or outside system an activity record ran as, including support sessions.

client/src/components/catalog/ResourceCa.name: Catalog card
client/src/components/catalog/ResourceCa.description: Presents one catalogue entry as a card with its icon, title, short summary and the action to open it.

client/src/components/config/ConfigDelet.name: Delete setting
client/src/components/config/ConfigDelet.description: Confirms before removing a saved setting value for an organization.

client/src/components/config/ConfigDialo.name: Setting editor
client/src/components/config/ConfigDialo.description: Adds or changes a saved setting and the organization it applies to.

client/src/components/dependencies/depen.name: Graph styling
client/src/components/dependencies/depen.description: Keeps the dependency graph's colours and spacing in step with the rest of the admin screens.

client/src/components/dependencies/Depen.name: Dependency graph
client/src/components/dependencies/Depen.description: Draws how workflows, forms, apps and agents depend on each other, laid out automatically.

client/src/components/dependencies/Depen.name: Graph controls
client/src/components/dependencies/Depen.description: Gives the dependency graph its zoom, fit and display controls.

client/src/components/dependencies/Depen.name: Dependency graph panel
client/src/components/dependencies/Depen.description: Frames the dependency graph with its loading, empty and error states.

client/src/components/dependencies/Depen.name: Graph viewport
client/src/components/dependencies/Depen.description: Fits a new graph into view without making a busy one unreadable.

client/src/components/dependencies/Entit.name: Dependency card
client/src/components/dependencies/Entit.description: Draws one workflow, form, app or agent in the graph, coloured by the kind of thing it is.

client/src/components/events/CreateEvent.name: Connect event source
client/src/components/events/CreateEvent.description: Walks an admin through connecting an outside system so its events can start automations.

client/src/components/events/CreateSubsc.name: New event subscription
client/src/components/events/CreateSubsc.description: Sets up which automation runs when a chosen kind of event arrives, and what details it receives.

client/src/components/events/DeliveriesT.name: Event deliveries
client/src/components/events/DeliveriesT.description: Lists each event handed to an automation, with whether it arrived and what came back.

client/src/components/events/DynamicConf.name: Connection settings form
client/src/components/events/DynamicConf.description: Builds the setup questions for a connection from that service's own list of fields.

client/src/components/events/EditEventSo.name: Edit event source
client/src/components/events/EditEventSo.description: Changes a connected event source's settings, sign-in details and which events it sends.

client/src/components/events/EditSubscri.name: Edit event subscription
client/src/components/events/EditSubscri.description: Changes when an event subscription fires and what it passes on to the automation.

client/src/components/events/EventDetail.name: Event detail
client/src/components/events/EventDetail.description: Opens one received event to show its details and what the automation did with it.

client/src/components/events/EventSource.name: Event source actions
client/src/components/events/EventSource.description: Offers the pause, test, edit and delete actions for a connected event source.

client/src/components/events/EventSource.name: Event source page
client/src/components/events/EventSource.description: Shows one connected event source's health, recent events and delivery history.

client/src/components/events/EventSource.name: Option loading status
client/src/components/events/EventSource.description: Reports when a choice list inside a connection form is loading, empty or failed.

client/src/components/events/EventsTable.name: Events list
client/src/components/events/EventsTable.description: Lists received events newest first, with status, source and a way into the details.

client/src/components/events/EventStatus.name: Event status badge
client/src/components/events/EventStatus.description: Shows at a glance whether an event was received, handled or failed.

client/src/components/events/EventTopicR.name: Event topic reference
client/src/components/events/EventTopicR.description: Lists the event types each connection can send, with examples to copy.

client/src/components/events/index.ts.name: Event screens
client/src/components/events/index.ts.description: Gathers the event screens so the rest of the admin app can reach them from one place.

client/src/components/events/InputMappin.name: Event field mapping
client/src/components/events/InputMappin.description: Maps details from an event into the values an automation expects.

client/src/components/events/MicrosoftGr.name: Microsoft 365 icon
client/src/components/events/MicrosoftGr.description: Shows the Microsoft 365 mark next to connections and events that come from Microsoft.

client/src/components/events/Subscriptio.name: Event subscriptions
client/src/components/events/Subscriptio.description: Lists every automation hooked to an event, with its state, filters and recent results.

client/src/components/forms/DataProvider.name: Data source inputs
client/src/components/forms/DataProvider.description: Sets the inputs passed to a data source: fixed values, answers from the form, or a calculated expression.
